items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I worked with Art for quite a while and I got this call from Nat Cole to come with him.

ctx.x: these signs up through Brooklyn and New York. I had bunions and -- but incidentally, half of the time most of the guys would want me to play with them, you know, and they'd want Art to play. Well, Art would go up and play, but I had to watch that money because I knew Art, you know, he was -- I was responsible to the people, you know, to the creditors, I should say. So I'd have to stay there and watch this money, but it would always hit on me to come and play.

So Art was going into some club on the east side, I can't think of it now, and he wanted me to play with him. So I promised him that I would so Slam was with him and I went with Art again. I worked with Art for quite a while and I got this call from Nat Cole to come with him. Well, I was under contract to Art, so Art gave me a little difficult time. He didn't want me to leave but finally he consented for me to leave, and I joined Nat, you know. And geez, I think I stayed with Nat for about 14 years.
You were doing that in what year?
